latest_release.name: Alpha 0.8.0
latest_release.body:
# Neural Rendering Supermod

This release spans two early access releases, 0.7.0 and 0.8.0, and now includes every main DLSS feature. All the features have been grouped into a modular "Supermod", so you can choose which ones you want to use from the overlay. A mod manager has also been added to improve the installation flow.

## Alpha 0.7.0

- Added DLSS Ray Reconstruction
- Added DLSS Super Resolution 4.5
- Added FSR Upscaling
- Added DLSS-SR and DLSS-RR inputs with Nvidia GPU spoofing
- Added XeSS inputs
- Any combination of inputs x outputs is possible, ie XeSS inputs with DLSS Neural Rendering and FSR upscaling
- Redesigned the overlay to be more usable with the new features
- New DirectX12 native mode: Improved smoothness and massively reduced the chance of interop-related stalls
- DLSS-NR, DLSS-RR and DLSS-SR now run in DirectX12 mode by default

## DLSS-NR on AMD mod
- Enabled temporal accumulation in pre-upscale mode
- 6-16% performance increase under heavy gameplay loads on DirectX12

## DLSS-RR on AMD mod
- Full native HIP and DirectX12 port of model F, works on games that provide DLSS-RR ray traced inputs, FSR-RR inputs will be added soon

## DLSS-SR on AMD mod
- DLSS-SR includes full native ports of models M and L, with more models coming soon

## NeuralHub
- Redesigned the installer as a game mod manager
- Installing the mod does not require copying the 150MB weights file + DLL into every game folder anymore
- Every large file is now centralized into a single copy, and the installed DLL is kept up to date from the manager
- Import your DLLs in settings to reuse them across all games


## Alpha 0.8.0

- Added DLSS Frame Generation
- FSR 4.1.1 upscaling is now bundled with the mod and no longer depends on your driver
- RDNA3: DirectX12 mode, DLSS-SR and DLSS-RR are now supported
- DLSS 310.9.16 DLLs are now accepted
- Improved performance and faster loading times across all networks

## DLSS-FG on AMD mod
- Works in games that offer DLSS Frame Generation inputs
- Up to x4 MFG
- Added HAGS bypass for older drivers/GPUs

## DLSS-NR on AMD mod
- New multipass mode: up to 3 passes per frame, each with its own style and intensities
- 25% performance improvement on RDNA3

## DLSS-RR on AMD mod
- Added support for RDNA3
- Accepts more input formats to increase game compatibility

## DLSS-SR on AMD mod
- Added support for RDNA3
- Added dynamic resolution support
- Model L now works at any upscaling ratio

## NeuralHub
- New onboarding guide
- GamePass games are now supported
- Install location for the mod can now be chosen manually
- Fixed Open folder and Open log
- Many small bug fixes

## Overlay
- New performance metrics with clearer indications of what's running

## Stability
- Fixed a rare failure to load the mod at game start
- Fixed a GPU memory leak

### Known issues:
- The new Epic games launcher is not yet supported
- Adding a game manually can fail for some games. Workaround: Copy the proxy DLL from an already installed game.

I am purchasing hardware to optimize and test. Support the development here: [ko-fi.com/danielblnc](https://ko-fi.com/danielblnc)
